notes.title: THE MAC UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello folks!

The DEFINITIVE EDITION is now available for [b]MAC[/b]! 

Spread the news and enjoy playing The Way of Life on your wonderful MAC.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123966/a779ae8f1dafd0902a91738129b9a6309c264c14.png[/img]

Thank you for your amazing support!
CyberCoconut Team!

notes.title: The Way of Life: DEFINITIVE EDITION - The UpdaTUX

tags.feature: Linux edition! That’s right, you can now play The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION on your Linux computer!

tags.bug: Settings: the VSync options are now properly saved, and will not reset on game start;
Windowed mode: it should now work properly and on every resolution;
Sounds: added missing footsteps sound in a few locations;
Tutorial: the symbols on the Library Keys are now displaying correctly when picked up;

tags.feature: Hub: the doors have been slightly altered to show which ones hold game levels inside. Indicators on each game door now show which level endings have been completed, so it’s easier to spot from the center of the hub which levels you haven’t played yet and how many endings you are missing.
